data.title: The Balance Scale
data.description: Let us find out which things are heavier and which are lighter

challenges.prompt: Which is heavier — the book or the feather?
challenges.hint: Put them both on. The side that goes DOWN is heavier.

challenges.prompt: Which is heavier — the rock or the brick?
challenges.hint: Put them both on. The side that goes DOWN is heavier.

challenges.prompt: Which is heavier — the apple or the feather?
challenges.hint: Put them both on. The side that goes DOWN is heavier.

challenges.prompt: Which is heavier — the leaf or the apple?
challenges.hint: Put them both on. The side that goes DOWN is heavier.

challenges.prompt: Which is heavier — the sock or the rock?
challenges.hint: Put them both on. The side that goes DOWN is heavier.
